title: 第46章 议会暗流第45章 星焰试炼双生
lines: 绮雯先动了。
刀锋擦着矿槽边缘划过去，暗影之刃上的净火钉进槽口。冷蓝火线顺着金属纹路窜开，刚翻上来的冷紫脉冲被硬压回去半寸。
“半刻太久。”她一脚踹开侧板，“走底路。”
绮兰抱紧封印匣，掌心星焰贴上匣盖，仓储母印一瞬全亮。她一句没问，直接跟上。
两人一前一后钻进心室右侧的检修夹道。身后黑钢封栅刚落死，整面石门就被旧核脉冲顶得一震。
夹道窄得只能容一人侧身，石壁里埋着旧城冷蓝管。绮雯手掌压墙，暗影共振一层层铺出去，低温回声顺着她指尖往前窜。
“左拐。三步，下坡。尽头检修井。”
绮兰跟着转过去，脚步没乱：“你听得倒清楚。”
“托长夏的福。”绮雯头也不回，“这人修暗路，比修脸上心。”
绮兰差点踩空，冷笑了一声：“那他脸是真没救了。”
两人冲到井口时，头顶传来第三声锁死回响。
绮兰抬手，星焰灌进井盖边缘的绮氏旧印。
咔哒。
井盖自己弹开。
井下连着旧试炼场外环回廊夹层。
两人才翻上去，显曜布下的冷蓝侦测环正沿回廊一圈圈扫。外侧石门轰然打开，梅洛带着抑制队冲了进来，手里的抑制桩都举起来了，差一点就把绮雯又捅回井里。
“看清人！”绮兰抬手一挡。
梅洛猛地刹住，灰头土脸地骂了句：“谢天谢地。再晚一口气，我连井都给你们钉死。”
洛晖从回廊另一端走过来，右臂袖口的冷蓝冰晶又厚了一层，步子却没乱。他先看封印匣，再看绮兰手里的转运令。
“东西呢？”
“都在。”绮兰把转运令塞进他手里，又把封印匣往上一提，“还有这个。绮仲私印，长夏旧指挥塔信格锁片。叔父这次跑不了。”
“他跑不跑，后面再算。”洛晖扫完转运令，抬眼看显曜，“东翼封存室还能用？”
显曜已经把侦测环移向学院外环穹顶：“能撑半个时辰。双生心室裂了，试炼场主门不能再做封证。送议会东翼，那里有审计符板。”
洛晖只说了一个字。
曜都，星痕议会东翼，临时封存室。
原本给贵族代表休整的外厅，已经被梅洛改成了审计区。地上铺满冷硬符板，四周堆着封缄卷宗箱，穹顶悬着显曜新布的冷蓝侦测环。外侧回廊每隔十步就站着一名星纹骑士，连窗棂都压上了抑制线。
洛晖把转运令拍上审计长桌，封印匣放在正中。
“记档。第三仓库废井，铁矿暗渠，长夏旧指挥塔信格锁片。今晚谁还敢说这是巧合，我把他脑袋按进卷宗箱，让他自己慢慢想。”
梅洛立刻招手，两个书记官抱着记录板冲上前。
绮兰没坐。
她直接站到长桌另一头，摘下手套，把掌心那道新生的星焰副纹亮出来。
“调绮氏第三仓库全部印记账册。启封、转运、封罐、代印人名单，一样都别漏。”
一名贵族代表皱起眉：“绮兰小姐，这等于把绮氏仓储全摊给议会。”
“那就摊。”
绮兰按住封印匣，声音不高，却砸得很硬。
“从现在起，谁再替我家仓库遮丑，我先剁谁的手。”
外厅一下静了。
content_en:
Qiwen moved first.
The blade scraped against the edge of the ore slot, and the pure fire nail on the Shadow Blade penetrated the slot. The cold blue fire line spread along the metal lines, and the cold purple pulse that had just been turned up was forced back half an inch.
"Half a moment is too long." She kicked the side board open and said, "Take the bottom road."
Qilan hugged the seal box tightly, the star flame in her palm pressed against the lid of the box, and the mother seal of the warehouse lit up for a moment. She didn't ask a question and just followed.
The two of them got into the access tunnel on the right side of the ventricle one after the other. As soon as the black steel barrier behind him fell down, the entire stone gate was shaken by the old nuclear pulse.
The passage is so narrow that it can only accommodate one person standing sideways, and the cold blue pipe of the old city is buried in the stone wall. Qiwen pressed her palms against the wall, and the shadow resonance spread out layer by layer, and low-temperature echoes traveled forward along her fingertips.
"Turn left. Three steps, downhill. Manhole at end."
Qilan turned around and kept her pace: "You heard me clearly."
"It's thanks to Chang Xia." Qiwen said without looking back, "This person builds a secret road, which is better than building a face."
Qilan almost missed the point and sneered: "Then his face is really hopeless."
When the two rushed to the mouth of the well, the third locking sound echoed above their heads.
Qilan raised her hand, and star flames poured into the Qi family's old seal on the edge of the manhole cover.
Click.
The manhole cover popped open on its own.
The shaft is connected to the mezzanine of the outer corridor of the old proving ground.
The two of them climbed up, and the cold blue detection ring placed by Xian Yao was sweeping along the corridor in circles. The outer stone door opened with a bang, and Mello rushed in with the suppression team. He raised the suppression stakes in his hands and almost pushed Qiwen back into the well.
"See the person clearly!" Qilan raised her hand to block her.
Mero stopped suddenly and cursed in disgrace: "Thank God. If I had taken one breath a little later, I would have nailed the well to you."
Luo Hui walked over from the other end of the corridor. The cold blue ice crystals on the cuffs of his right arm were thicker, but his steps were not messy. He looked at the sealing box first, and then at the transfer order in Qilan's hand.
"Where's the stuff?"
"They are all here." Qilan put the transfer order into his hand and lifted the sealing box, "And this. Qizhong's private seal, the letter lock plate of the old command tower in Changxia. My uncle can't run away this time."
"Whether he runs away or not depends on it later." Luo Hui scanned the transfer order and looked up at Xian Yao, "Can the storage room in the east wing still be used?"
Xian Yao has moved the detection ring to the outer dome of the academy: "It can last for half an hour. The twin ventricles are broken, and the main door of the trial ground can no longer be sealed. Send it to the east wing of the parliament, where there is an audit talisman board."
Luo Hui only said one word.
"Let's go."
…
Yaodu, east wing of Starhen Council, temporary storage room.
The outer hall, which was originally used for aristocratic representatives to rest, has been transformed into an audit area by Mello. The ground is covered with cold talisman boards, sealed file boxes are piled around, and a new cold blue detection ring hung from the dome. A star-patterned knight stood every ten steps in the outer corridor, and even the window lattice was covered with suppression lines.
Luo Hui slapped the transfer order on the auditor's desk and placed the seal box in the middle.
"Record the files. The abandoned shaft of the third warehouse, the culvert of the iron mine, the letter lock plate of the old command tower in Changxia. Who dares to say this is a coincidence tonight, I pressed his head into the file box and let him think about it."
Mello immediately waved, and two clerks rushed forward holding the record board.
Qilan didn't sit down.
She stood directly at the other end of the long table, took off her gloves, and showed the new star flame pattern on her palm.
"Tune all the imprinted account books of Qi's third warehouse. Don't miss out on the unsealing, transshipment, sealing, and list of people who printed on behalf of the people."
A representative of the nobles frowned: "Miss Qilan, this is equivalent to giving the entire Qi family's warehouse to the parliament."
"Then let's spread it."
Qilan pressed the sealing box, her voice was not loud, but she hit it hard.
"From now on, whoever covers up the ugliness of my warehouse will have his hand chopped off first."
The outer hall fell silent for a moment.
